lesson.subtitle: Lesson 6 -- This Week’s Status Update
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fernanda Bassani Rubio | Lesson 6 -- This Week’s Status Update
lesson.grammar_point: present continuous for actions in progress

listenings.text: OK, my update. This week I am working on two things. First, I am updating the forecast for the new adhesive. It is a little behind schedule, because I am waiting for numbers from two customers. I think I can finish it on Thursday. Second, I am preparing the quotes for the launch. That is on track. One issue: our system is very slow this week, so everything takes more time. The IT team is working on it. My priority is the forecast. That's all from me.

Hello, Fernanda. So, the trial. We are testing your adhesive on two lines at the factory. On the first line, everything is going well. On the second line, we have a small issue: the adhesive is drying a little too slowly when the factory is cold, in the early morning. My engineers are working on it with your lab team. For me, it is not a big problem. The trial is still on track. We are finishing the tests next Friday, and then I am sending you the full report.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a problem that you need to solve
a test of a product in real conditions
to spend time doing or improving something
a short report on how a project is going
the moment a new product starts to be sold
the most important thing to do first
going as planned, with no delay

paras: Hello team, here is this week's status update. Our customer in France is running a trial of the new battery adhesive at the factory. The trial started on Monday, and it is on track. Julien's team is testing the adhesive in real conditions, at high and low temperatures. The first results are good.

We have one issue. The new packaging is not ready, because the supplier is changing the design. For this reason, the launch is two weeks behind schedule. It is now planned for the middle of November. We are working on a new plan with the supplier, and I am talking to them every day this week.

Our priority this week is the trial. The lab team is preparing a short report for the customer, and Priya is updating the forecast. We aren't waiting for the packaging to start the sales plan: the sales team is already talking to three car makers. Next update: Wednesday, Week 39. Best, Anna.
